eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Twelve
subtitle: Lesson 98 · Database Design Fundamentals

code:
ALTER TABLE dbo.LessonDemo
ADD Notes NVARCHAR(200) NULL;
caption: The new column appears as NULL on every existing row — almost always safe.

code:
ALTER TABLE dbo.LessonDemo
ALTER COLUMN Label NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL;
caption: Widening a column is usually safe. Narrowing one is where the real caveat starts.
SQL Server checks existing data first — one bad row rejects the whole statement.

code:
ALTER TABLE dbo.LessonDemo
DROP COLUMN Notes;
caption: Removes the column and every value in it, for every row. No undo short of a backup.

subtitle: Removing a table entirely — and the safe modern way to do it.
